episodes.title: The Guest Who Couldn't Leave
episodes.description: A young lawyer visits Count Dracula's castle, and discovers he is never meant to leave.

scenes.narration: Jonathan looked into the mirror. The Count was standing right behind him. The mirror showed no one.
scenes.visual: A small hand mirror reflecting only Jonathan and an empty room behind him

scenes.narration: Three days earlier, an entire village had begged him not to come here.
scenes.visual: Frightened villagers crowding around a young traveller in a candlelit mountain inn

scenes.narration: An old woman pushed a crucifix into his hand. Evil walks tonight, she whispered.
scenes.visual: An old peasant woman pressing a small silver crucifix into Jonathan's palm

scenes.narration: At midnight, a black carriage came for him. Its driver's eyes glowed red.
scenes.visual: A tall cloaked coachman holding the reins, face in shadow, eyes glowing red

scenes.narration: Wolves circled them in the dark, until the driver raised one hand, and every wolf went silent.
scenes.visual: The coachman raising a pale hand as wolves cower in a ring around the carriage

scenes.narration: At the castle, Count Dracula welcomed him. Tall. Pale. Ice cold to the touch.
scenes.visual: A tall old nobleman holding an antique oil lamp in an arched stone doorway

scenes.narration: He never ate, and Jonathan never saw him by day.
scenes.visual: Jonathan dining alone at a long candlelit table while the Count watches from the shadows

scenes.narration: Then came the mirror. The razor slipped, and the Count lunged at the blood on his throat.
scenes.visual: The Count lunging forward with blazing red eyes and clawed hands

scenes.narration: Only the crucifix stopped him.
scenes.visual: The Count recoiling from a small glowing crucifix on Jonathan's chest

scenes.narration: That night, Jonathan tried the doors. Every single one was locked.
scenes.visual: Jonathan pulling at a heavy iron-bound locked door in a dark stone corridor

scenes.narration: From his window, he watched the Count crawl head first down the castle wall, like a lizard.
scenes.visual: The Count crawling face-down down a sheer stone wall, cloak spread like bat wings

scenes.narration: Desperate, he slept in a forbidden room, and woke to three women bending over him, teeth bared.
scenes.visual: Three pale women in flowing white gowns leaning over a sleeping man in moonlight

scenes.narration: The Count hurled them back. This man is mine, he snarled. When I am done, you may have him.
scenes.visual: The Count furious, eyes blazing, flinging the women away from the couch

scenes.narration: So Jonathan climbed down the wall himself, and found the Count asleep in a box of earth, lips red with blood.
scenes.visual: The Count lying in a box of earth in a crypt, eyes open, blood on his lips

scenes.narration: Fifty boxes like it were loaded onto wagons that morning. Bound for London.
scenes.visual: Workmen loading large wooden crates onto horse wagons in a castle courtyard

scenes.narration: And Jonathan was left behind with the three women. In Part 2, the Count reaches England, and chooses his victim.
scenes.visual: Jonathan at a window as three pale figures appear in the dark corridor behind him

episodes.title: The Lady in White
episodes.description: The Count reaches England and fixes his eyes on one young woman. Nobody can save her.

scenes.narration: The ship crashed into the harbour with a dead captain tied to the wheel, and no crew at all.
scenes.visual: A dead sea captain lashed to a ship's wheel in a raging storm, a crucifix bound in his hands

scenes.narration: A huge black dog leapt from the deck and vanished into the graveyard.
scenes.visual: A huge black dog leaping from a ship's bow onto a beach at night

scenes.narration: Its only cargo: fifty boxes of earth. The Count had arrived in England.
scenes.visual: Rows of wooden crates in a dark ship's hold

scenes.narration: In that same town, Lucy had just said yes to Arthur, the man she loved.
scenes.visual: Arthur kneeling before Lucy in a sunlit garden

scenes.narration: But she had started walking in her sleep.
scenes.visual: Lucy in a white nightgown walking with closed eyes down a dark hallway

scenes.narration: One night, her best friend Mina found her bed empty, and ran to the clifftop graveyard.
scenes.visual: Mina in a shawl running through cobbled night streets toward a ruined abbey

scenes.narration: Something dark was bent over Lucy's throat. It lifted a face with burning red eyes.
scenes.visual: A long dark figure bending over a woman in white on a graveyard bench, red eyes glowing

scenes.narration: On her neck were two tiny red marks.
scenes.visual: Close-up of two small puncture marks on a pale throat

scenes.narration: Back in London, Lucy lost blood every night, and no doctor could say why.
scenes.visual: Lucy deathly pale in bed in a Victorian bedroom, Arthur holding her hand

scenes.narration: Only one man guessed the truth. Professor Van Helsing.
scenes.visual: An elderly professor with a doctor's bag arriving at a London townhouse at night

scenes.narration: He hung garlic flowers around her window, and made everyone swear not to touch them.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing hanging wreaths of white garlic flowers around a window

scenes.narration: That night, her mother threw them away, and opened the window.
scenes.visual: An open window at night, garlic flowers scattered on the floor, curtains blowing

scenes.narration: A wolf smashed through the glass.
scenes.visual: A great grey wolf crashing through a bedroom window in a shower of glass

scenes.narration: Dying, Lucy begged Arthur for a kiss, in a voice that wasn't hers. Her teeth had grown sharp.
scenes.visual: Lucy reaching up toward Arthur with half-closed eyes, sharp teeth glinting

scenes.narration: Van Helsing dragged him back. Moments later, Lucy was dead.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing seizing Arthur's arm and pulling him away from the bed

scenes.narration: Days later, children began to vanish at night, led away by a beautiful lady in white.
scenes.visual: Lucy in a white burial gown leading a small child through a misty graveyard

scenes.narration: In Part 3, the final part, they open Lucy's coffin, and the hunt for the Count begins.
scenes.visual: An open empty coffin in a crypt, lantern light

episodes.title: The Final Hunt
episodes.description: The hunters chase the Count across Europe in a race against the setting sun.

scenes.narration: Arthur raised the stake over the woman he loved.
scenes.visual: Arthur holding a wooden stake and a hammer, hands shaking

scenes.narration: Lucy had risen from her grave to feed on children. This was the only way to set her free.
scenes.visual: Lucy in white, arms outstretched, smiling coldly by a tomb door at night

scenes.narration: One blow, and she was at peace. Now the hunters knew what they were facing.
scenes.visual: Lucy's face serene and gentle in her coffin, warm light

scenes.narration: The Count slept by day in fifty boxes of earth, hidden across London.
scenes.visual: A map of London marked with pins and small drawings of crates

scenes.narration: Box by box, they sealed them with holy bread.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing crumbling a white wafer into an open crate of earth

scenes.narration: But while they hunted him, he was hunting Mina.
scenes.visual: Silhouette of the Count gripping a woman by a moonlit window, cloak swirling

scenes.narration: They burst in to find him forcing her to drink his blood. He vanished as mist.
scenes.visual: The Count recoiling and snarling from a raised white wafer

scenes.narration: Mina was left with a burning red scar on her forehead.
scenes.visual: A red burn mark on Mina's forehead, her eyes closed in pain

scenes.narration: Cornered, the Count fled for home with his last box.
scenes.visual: The Count leaping through a window in a burst of glass

scenes.narration: But his bite had linked his mind to Mina's. In a trance, she could hear him: water, chains, a ship.
scenes.visual: Van Helsing hypnotising Mina by candlelight, moving his hands before her eyes

scenes.narration: The hunters raced across Europe after him.
scenes.visual: A steam train racing through Eastern European countryside

scenes.narration: Below his castle, three women rose from the snow, calling Mina their sister. A circle of holy bread held them back.
scenes.visual: Mina inside a faintly glowing circle in the snow, the women outside it

scenes.narration: Then, at sunset, the wagon carrying his box raced for the castle gates. If the sun set first, he would wake.
scenes.visual: A red sun sinking behind snowy peaks, a wagon racing below

scenes.narration: They tore off the lid. His red eyes snapped open.
scenes.visual: The Count lying in a box of earth, red eyes snapping open in the sunset glow

scenes.narration: Jonathan's knife cut his throat. Quincey's blade found his heart.
scenes.visual: Two blades striking down into a box, silhouetted against the setting sun

scenes.narration: The Count crumbled to dust. The scar vanished from Mina's forehead.
scenes.visual: A figure crumbling into dust that drifts away in red sunset light

scenes.narration: Quincey, mortally wounded, died smiling. They had won.
scenes.visual: Quincey lying in the snow smiling, friends kneeling around him
